headline: Last session: Sensex crossed 81,000 and Nifty settled above 25,000; markets remain closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: NSE and BSE are closed today on account of the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday.
In the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices extended gains to close at their highest levels in over eight months.
Sensex ended 107 points higher and crossed the 81,000 mark on the last trading day.
Nifty settled above the key 25,000 level in the previous session.
whatHappening: Blackstone is set to become a key investor in IIFL Finance with a 15% stake.
Data Patterns shares surged 9% during the previous trading session.
Sensex and Nifty closed in the green, touching their highest levels in over eight months.
Trading on BSE and NSE will resume on Wednesday, 11 November.
summary:
Indian equity markets are closed today for the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday.
On the last trading day, Sensex surpassed 81,000 and Nifty closed above 25,000, marking eight-month highs.
Normal market operations will resume on Wednesday, 11 November.
